title: Bike Sharing
author: Hadi Fanaee-T
changes: All hourly rows retained. Selected columns parsed as numbers; original normalized temperature retained in the stored records. Browser converts hourly temp to Celsius using the current UCI definition (temp * 47 - 8), groups at 10/20/30 Celsius, and filters and averages the observed rows. No synthetic rows or zero-filled missing hours.
temperatureNote: Celsius display follows the current UCI hourly definition: (t - (-8)) / (39 - (-8)); inverse t = temp * 47 - 8. The legacy ZIP README instead describes division by 41; it is preserved unchanged as a source document. Displayed Celsius values use the current landing-page definition, verified 2026-10-07.
countsNote: UCI landing-page Instances says 17389, but the downloaded hour.csv and ZIP README have 17379 hourly records. Counts here are verified from the actual file.

chartScales.note: Fixed per comparison mode across every year/work/weather filter combination.
